The '''Alchenaut system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Alchenaut sector/Legends|Alchenaut sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alchenaut]].
